summary: Changed selectedDogId useState initializer in OwnerDashboardClient.tsx from dogs[0]?.id to a lazy initializer that finds the first dog where setup is incomplete (no active walker OR active walker with zero price), falling back to dogs[0] if all dogs are complete.
